cases.rationale: Two actual people are visible on the dusty field. The foreground person holds a black baseball fielding mitt, with its broad pocket and fingers visible; it is not merely a batting glove. Corrugated fencing, buildings, ground and unpotted trees supply no identifiable objects under the other definitions. All 75 definitions and exclusions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real brown bear is identifiable by its complete furry body, rounded ears, long muzzle and legs amid low vegetation. It is not a plush toy or another listed animal. The plants grow in open ground without pots. All 75 definitions were considered against the entire crop; no other listed object is visible and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Actual players and an umpire occupy the baseball field. A fielding mitt is visible with the catcher in front of the umpire; the batter's handwear alone would not qualify. The net, field, stadium wall and scoreboard are not additional listed objects; scoreboard numbers are not an identifiable time-of-day clock. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual airborne snowboarder is attached by boots and bindings to a snowboard. A dark pack behind the shoulders and the green shoulder/chest/waist straps identify a worn backpack. Clothing, goggles, sky and an unpotted conifer do not meet other definitions; the board is not a skateboard or surfboard. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

People stand among bamboo rafts on the water; the rafts are actual watercraft. Several multicolored canopies have umbrella ribs/poles. Individual woven chair backs and seats are identifiable. Bench (13) remains unclear because some long transverse bamboo structures could be seats or raft supports rather than a definite multi-person bench. Handbag (26) remains unclear: the foreground woman's diagonal strap and partly cropped material at her hip do not resolve an actual shoulder-bag body. The green hills are unpotted and flags are not kites. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered.

Bread with ham and egg filling identifies a sandwich, and the tall brown-liquid vessel has a bottle body and narrow open neck. The open notebook computer has its integrated screen and keyboard/base visible, qualifying as laptop and keyboard, not standalone TV. Potted plant (58) is unclear because the blurred green background form and possible container do not resolve plant-and-pot identity. Dining table (60) is unclear because the meal rests on a speckled surface whose table-versus-counter identity is unresolved. The flat plate is not a bowl; no identifiable cutlery is present. All 75 definitions were considered.

The toilet has an identifiable tank, seat and bowl. The right-hand washbasin and faucet identify a sink. A tissue box, shower curtain, window, wall tiles and mirror do not satisfy other listed definitions. The small green item on the sink ledge supplies no identifiable bristled toothbrush head or bottle body and neck. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real perched bird has identifiable head, beak, wings, body and feet. The red/yellow fruit with exposed pale bitten flesh is an apple, not an orange or decorative fruit. Branches and leaves have no pot context. After considering all 75 definitions, no other listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

An actual person reclines on an upholstered couch with a small cat at her lap. A handled drinking mug sits at lower left. Narrow-neck cleaning bottles, a sink/faucet, the conventional range/oven and the separate microwave above it are visible in the kitchen. A dark slatted single-person chair is visible at rear right. Dining table (60) remains unclear: a dark rear horizontal surface near the chair is too obscured to distinguish an eating table from other furniture. The kitchen counters and sofa cushions are not dining tables or beds. Each of the 75 definitions was considered.

The actual person is holding a mobile phone. Broad gray shoulder straps connected to the pack sides identify a backpack, and a long white tied necktie lies over the dark hoodie. The metal elevator panel and its buttons are not a refrigerator, remote or standalone monitor. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The room contains a white dining chair beside the cropped eating table at left, burgundy sofa upholstery in the foreground, a standalone TV at right and a round wall clock. The kitchen includes an identifiable microwave, sink/faucet and narrow-neck bottles. Cup (41) is unclear because small white items among the cookware do not resolve a drinking vessel. Refrigerator (72) is unclear because the partly obscured white appliance behind the peninsula resembles a compact refrigerator but its door/body details are insufficient to rule out cabinetry. The exposed cooktop alone does not identify an oven, and the front-loading machine is a washer. All 75 definitions were considered.

A real pale cat sits on a computer work desk in front of an actual standalone monitor. The separate white computer keyboard is visible. Mouse (64) remains unclear because the dark form beside and beneath the cat overlaps its tail and the pad, preventing a determinate input-device identification. Book (73) remains unclear because cropped printed material at right could be bound pages or loose papers. The monitor is not an integrated laptop and the desk is not an eating table; the large gray object at right is office equipment. All 75 definitions were considered.
